subject: Physics

The work function of the metal

subject: Physics

prompt: In a nuclear fission reactor, what is the primary function of a moderator such as heavy water (D²O) or graphite?

To absorb all neutrons and shut down the core
To accelerate electrons into the core
To shield operators from gamma rays

subject: Physics

Both Z and A remain unchanged

One up quark and one anti-down quark
